title: Spatial Omics in High-Grade Gliomas: Mapping Immune-Tumor Niches for Precision Therapy.
snippet: High-grade gliomas (HGGs), particularly glioblastoma (GBM), remain among the most lethal human cancers despite decades of molecular profiling and therapeutic innovation. title: Predicting Targeted and Immunotherapeutic Response Outcomes in Melanoma With Single-Cell Raman Spectroscopy and Artificial Intelligence.

title: Black Rice Anthocyanin-Hyaluronic Acid Complex Alleviates Hyperuricemia-Associated Renal Injury Through Synergistic Inhibition of the TLR4/NF-κB Pathway and Modulation of Uric Acid Transport.
